result.title: Spectral Geometry of Attention: From Information Routing to Uncertainty
result.comment: This paper has been accepted as poster at Neurips 2026
result.summary: In this work, we study transformer attention through the lens of spectral geometry and operator theory. We view each attention head as a functional map between Hilbert spaces of functions on the token sequence and derive a Token Difference Operator, whose spectral structure controls how token-space information is routed to the output. We show that standard Euclidean spectra are structurally biased by sinks, conflating mass concentration with genuine routing capacity. By recasting token space in the intrinsic probability geometry induced by attention, the token difference spectrum disentangles sink effects from routing capacity and provides a spectral description of the dimensionality of the head output. This yields a unified framework for analyzing attention maps, explaining sinks, routing collapse, and output dimensionality within a single operator-theoretic framework. In practice, by grounding attention heuristics in spectral geometry, we develop a novel attention-based uncertainty estimator that complements probability-based scores, with the largest gains on long-context inputs.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文用谱几何与算子理论刻画 transformer 注意力，把每个注意力头视为 token 序列函数空间之间的映射，定义 Token Difference Operator，并将 token 空间重新嵌入注意力诱导的内在概率几何，以区分 sink 效应与真实路由容量，进而统一解释 sink、路由坍缩与头部输出维度，并据此提出一种基于注意力的不确定性估计器。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「路由容量与输出维度」的谱刻画可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的信息坍缩、视觉旁路与注意力结构（深度、位置、缓存）对 similar 度的影响提供分析视角；所提不确定性估计器与长上下文收益也可能与 STOP 决策和证据筛选相关，但均属概念线索，需核查是否触及多模态推理状态本身。
